description: Download a message attachment from Discord into the local download folder (DISCORD_MCP_DOWNLOAD_DIR, default ~/Downloads/discord-mcp). Requires the message ID and the specific attachment ID (attachment_id comes from the attachments of discord_get_message). Returns local file path, size, content type and SHA-256 hash. Bot permissions it may need: View Channel, Read Message History. Writes a file to the local download folder and changes nothing in Discord.

attachment_id.description: ID of the attachment to download (from the attachments array of discord_get_message)

channel_id.description: ID of the channel or thread that holds the message

name: discord_download_attachment

attachment_id.description: Discord snowflake ID as a numeric string
